name: 考研乱序词汇
description: 考研英语乱序核心词汇

words.definition: vi. 反抗；反叛；反感，厌恶
words.example: The prime minister is now facing a revolt by members of his own party.
words.exampleTranslation: 首相现在面临着党内倒戈。

words.definition: n. 专家；专门医师
words.example: an attorney who is a specialist in banking law
words.exampleTranslation: 一名专攻银行法的律师

words.definition: vt. 在…上铺地毯，把地毯铺在…上；斥责
words.example: My bedroom carpet is green.
words.exampleTranslation: 我卧室里的地毯是绿色的。

words.definition: n. 冥想；沉思，深思
words.example: Yoga involves breathing exercises, stretching, and meditation.
words.exampleTranslation: 瑜伽包括呼吸训练、伸展和冥想。

words.definition: vi. 存留，坚持；持续，固执
words.example: ‘I don’t think it’s right,’ John persisted.
words.exampleTranslation: “我认为那不对。”约翰坚持说道。

words.definition: vt. 避免；避开，躲避；消除
words.example: Road safety is taught to young children to avoid road accidents.
words.exampleTranslation: 小孩子受到道路安全知识的教育，以避免交通事故。

words.definition: adj. [光]黄色的；黄皮肤的
words.example: yellow flowers
words.exampleTranslation: 黄花

words.definition: vt. 查阅；商量；向…请教
words.example: If symptoms persist, consult a doctor without delay.
words.exampleTranslation: 如果症状持续的话，马上咨询医生。

words.definition: vt. 承担；假定；采取；呈现
words.example: I think we can safely assume (=  it is almost certain  ) that interest rates will go up again soon.
words.exampleTranslation: 我想我们几乎可以肯定，利率很快会再次上调。

words.definition: n. 博士学位；博士头衔
words.example: Professor Lanphier obtained his doctorate in social psychology from the University of Michigan.
words.exampleTranslation: 兰菲尔教授从密歇根大学获得了社会心理学博士学位。

words.definition: n. 合力；结果；[化学]生成物
words.example: She is still trying to get over the attack and the resultant injuries.
words.exampleTranslation: 她仍在努力从袭击以及由此造成的伤害中恢复过来。

words.definition: vi. 融合；熔化，熔融
words.example: two 13 amp fuses
words.exampleTranslation: 两根13安培的保险丝

words.definition: adj. 恰好是，正是；甚至；十足的；特有的
words.example: It feels very cold today.
words.exampleTranslation: 今天很冷。

words.definition: n. 批评家，评论家；爱挑剔的人
words.example: Mather was a film critic for many years.
words.exampleTranslation: 马瑟做过多年的电影评论家。

words.definition: adj. 有独创性的；机灵的，精制的；心灵手巧的
words.example: Many fish have ingenious ways of protecting their eggs from predators.
words.exampleTranslation: 很多鱼都有绝妙的方法来保护它们产的卵不被捕食者吃掉。

words.definition: n. [地理]大陆，洲，陆地
words.example: the continents of Asia and Africa
words.exampleTranslation: 亚洲及非洲大陆

words.definition: n. 住宅，住处；居住
words.example: the ambassador’s official residence
words.exampleTranslation: 大使官邸

words.definition: n. 木偶；傀儡；受他人操纵的人
words.example: a 20-minute puppet show
words.exampleTranslation: 20分钟的木偶表演

words.definition: n. [经]顾问；咨询者；会诊医生
words.example: a management consultant
words.exampleTranslation: 管理顾问

words.definition: n. 预备；准备
words.example: This dish is good for dinner parties because much of the preparation can be done ahead of time.
words.exampleTranslation: 这道菜适合宴会，因为很多准备工作可以事先做好。

words.definition: vt. 假定；推测；擅自；意味着
words.example: I presume you're here on business.
words.exampleTranslation: 我想你是来这儿出差的吧。

words.definition: n. 晶体管
words.example: Every transistor has at least three electrodes.
words.exampleTranslation: 每个晶体管至少有三个电极。

words.definition: adj. 在前的；在先的
words.example: The trial could set an important precedent for dealing with similar cases.
words.exampleTranslation: 这次审判能为处理类似案件开创一个重要先例。

words.definition: n. 能力；[物]容量；资格，地位；生产力
words.example: The room had seating capacity for about 80.
words.exampleTranslation: 这房间能坐80个人左右。

words.definition: n. 政党，党派；聚会，派对；[法]当事人
words.example: We’re having a small party this evening to celebrate our wedding anniversary.
words.exampleTranslation: 我们今晚有个小聚会，庆祝我们的结婚纪念日。

words.definition: n. [数]方程式，等式；相等；[化学]反应式
words.example: In the equation 2x + 1 = 7, what is x?
words.exampleTranslation: 在方程式2x+1=7中，x的值为多少？

words.definition: vt. 开始；着手
words.example: Work will commence on the new building immediately.
words.exampleTranslation: 新大楼即将破土动工。

words.definition: vt. 疏忽，忽视；忽略
words.example: Many of these ideas have been neglected by modern historians.
words.exampleTranslation: 这些观点有许多都被现代的历史学家忽略了。

words.definition: n. 同时代的人；同时期的东西
words.example: She writes a lot of contemporary music for people like Whitney Houston.
words.exampleTranslation: 她为惠特尼·休斯敦等人创作大量当代音乐作品。

words.definition: adj. 连续的,持续的
words.example: continuous economic growth
words.exampleTranslation: 持续的经济增长

words.definition: n. 解决方案；溶液；[化学]溶解；解答
words.example: The best solution would be for them to separate.
words.exampleTranslation: 最好的解决方法是他们分开。

words.definition: n. 决定，决心；决议
words.example: Do you ever wonder if you made the right decision?
words.exampleTranslation: 你怀疑过自己所作的决定是否正确吗？

words.definition: n. 关怀；照料；谨慎；忧虑
words.example: high standards of medical care
words.exampleTranslation: 高水平的医疗护理

words.definition: n. 政治家，政客
words.example: politicians who are trying to get the minority vote
words.exampleTranslation: 努力争取少数族群选票的政治家

words.definition: adj. 鉴定的；[核]临界的；批评的，爱挑剔的；危险的；决定性的；评论的
words.example: He made some highly critical remarks.
words.exampleTranslation: 他发表了一些严厉的批判性言论。

words.definition: vi. 获得；流行
words.example: Evans was trying to obtain a false passport and other documents.
words.exampleTranslation: 埃文斯当时正试图获取假护照和其他文件。

words.definition: adj. [电][植保]抵抗的，反抗的；顽固的
words.example: an infection that’s resistant to antibiotics
words.exampleTranslation: 对抗生素有抗药性的感染

words.definition: v. 造成，形成；摆姿势；装模作样；提出…讨论
words.example: Ann struck a pose (= stood or sat in a particular position ) and smiled for the camera.
words.exampleTranslation: 安摆好姿势露出笑脸准备拍照。

words.definition: adj. 生动的；鲜明的；鲜艳的
words.example: I’ve got vivid memories of that summer.
words.exampleTranslation: 我对那年夏天记忆犹新。

words.definition: n. [计量]毫米
words.example: A micrometer is one thousandth of one millimeter.
words.exampleTranslation: 一微米是一毫米的千分之一。

words.definition: n. 颤抖，战栗；碎片
words.example: Jake stood shivering in the cold air.
words.exampleTranslation: 大冷天里，杰克站着冻得瑟瑟发抖。

words.definition: v. 使…加剧; 加剧
words.example: The fighting on the border is escalating.
words.exampleTranslation: 边境地区的战事在不断升级。

words.definition: vi. 毕业；渐变
words.example: a Harvard graduate
words.exampleTranslation: 哈佛毕业生

words.definition: n. 精神；心灵；情绪；志气；烈酒
words.example: I’m 85, but I still feel young in spirit.
words.exampleTranslation: 我 85 岁了，但心依然感觉年轻。

words.definition: n. [数]矛盾；否认；反驳
words.example: apparent contradictions in the defendant’s testimony
words.exampleTranslation: 被告证词中的明显矛盾

words.definition: n. [数]值；[经]价值；价格；重要性；确切涵义
words.example: The alterations doubled the value of the house
words.exampleTranslation: 经改建后这所房子增值了一倍。

words.definition: vt. 沐浴；用水洗
words.example: I bathed, washed my hair, and got dressed.
words.exampleTranslation: 我洗了澡，洗了头，然后穿上衣服。

words.definition: n. 成功，成就；胜利；大获成功的人或事物
words.example: The experiment was a big success.
words.exampleTranslation: 实验非常成功。

words.definition: adj. 真实的，真正的；诚恳的
words.example: ‘Did he really?’ Her surprise seemed genuine.
words.exampleTranslation: “他真的这样？”她好像是真的惊讶。

words.definition: n. [水运]港口，口岸；（计算机的）[电子][计]端口；[航][船]左舷；舱门
words.example: We’ll have two days ashore while the ship is in port.
words.exampleTranslation: 轮船靠港时，我们能在岸上待两天。

words.definition: n. [金融]货币；通货
words.example: The bank can supply you with foreign currency .
words.exampleTranslation: 这家银行能为你提供外币。

words.definition: n. 繁荣，成功
words.example: a time of economic prosperity
words.exampleTranslation: 经济繁荣时期

words.definition: vt. 扩张；使膨胀；详述
words.example: Water expands as it freezes.
words.exampleTranslation: 水结冰时会膨胀。

words.definition: n. 妇女；女性；成年女子
words.example: I was talking to a woman I met on the flight.
words.exampleTranslation: 我正和一个在飞机上认识的女子交谈。

words.definition: vt. 管理；经营；控制；设法
words.example: He was asked to manage a new department.
words.exampleTranslation: 他被要求去管理一个新的部门。

words.definition: adj. 异常的，例外的
words.example: A review panel concluded that there were no exceptional circumstances that would warrant a lesser penalty for him.
words.exampleTranslation: 一个评估小组作出结论：没有什么例外情况可使他获得从轻惩罚

words.definition: n. 满意，满足；赔偿；乐事；赎罪
words.example: She got great satisfaction from helping people to learn.
words.exampleTranslation: 她在帮助人们学习的过程中得到很大的满足。

words.definition: n. 情绪，语气；心境；气氛
words.example: You’re in a good mood this morning!
words.exampleTranslation: 你今天早晨心情不错啊！

words.definition: n. [经]企业；事业；进取心；事业心
words.example: state/public enterprise (=one owned by the government)
words.exampleTranslation: 国有企业/公共事业单位

words.definition: adv. 因此；结果；所以
words.example: Most computer users have never received any formal keyboard training. Consequently, their keyboard skills are inefficient.
words.exampleTranslation: 大多数的电脑使用者都没有经过正规的键盘操作训练，因此他们的键盘技巧不够熟练。

words.definition: vt. 侵略；侵袭；侵扰；涌入
words.example: The Romans invaded Britain 2,000 years ago.
words.exampleTranslation: 2,000年前古罗马人入侵了英国。

words.definition: vt. 改正；告诫
words.example: If my calculations are correct, we’re about ten miles from Exeter.
words.exampleTranslation: 如果我计算得没错的话，我们离埃克塞特大约十英里。

words.definition: n. 对称（性）；整齐，匀称
words.example: ...the incredible beauty and symmetry of a snowflake.
words.exampleTranslation: …雪花令人难以置信的美丽和对称。

words.definition: n. [军]钢盔，头盔
words.example: The Sword split the Knight's helmet and bit him fatally.
words.exampleTranslation: 剑劈开了骑士的头盔并致命地刺进他。

words.definition: n. [物]时间；时代；次数；节拍；倍数
words.example: Einstein changed the way we think about space and time.
words.exampleTranslation: 爱因斯坦改变了我们的时空概念。

words.definition: n. 观察；视野；意见；风景
words.example: What’s your view on the subject?
words.exampleTranslation: 你对这个问题怎么看？

words.definition: n. 收到；收据；收入
words.example: Keep your receipt in case you want to bring it back.
words.exampleTranslation: 保留收据以备退货之需。

words.definition: n. [管理]管理；管理人员；管理部门；操纵；经营手段
words.example: a lack of management skills
words.exampleTranslation: 缺乏管理技巧

words.definition: adj. 完美的；最好的；精通的
words.example: His English was perfect.
words.exampleTranslation: 他的英语很地道。

words.definition: n. [电]导体；[交]售票员；领导者；管理人
words.example: Wood is a poor conductor of heat.
words.exampleTranslation: 木头导热性能差。

words.definition: adj. [医]客观的；目标的；[语]宾格的
words.example: He vowed to achieve certain objectives before the end of his presidency.
words.exampleTranslation: 他立誓要在他的总统任期结束之前实现某些目标。

words.definition: n. 饮料
words.example: Beer is a beverage of the remotest time.
words.exampleTranslation: 啤酒是一种最古老的饮料。

words.definition: vt. 操纵；操作；巧妙地处理；篡改
words.example: He was one of those men who manipulated people.
words.exampleTranslation: 他是那种要摆布别人的人。

words.definition: n. 副本；配对物；极相似的人或物
words.example: As soon as he heard what was afoot, he telephoned his German and Italian counterparts to protest.
words.exampleTranslation: 他一听到在进行中的事，马上就给德国和意大利相应人员打电话抗议。

words.definition: vt. 迫害；困扰；同…捣乱
words.example: The Puritans left England to escape being persecuted.
words.exampleTranslation: 清教徒离开了英国以躲避迫害。

words.definition: adj. 婚姻的；夫妇间的
words.example: marital problems
words.exampleTranslation: 婚姻问题

words.definition: n. [机]螺旋；旋涡；螺旋形之物
words.example: ...a spiral staircase.
words.exampleTranslation: …一段旋梯。

words.definition: vt. 指定；指派；标出；把…定名为
words.example: The lake was recently designated a conservation area.
words.exampleTranslation: 这个湖最近被指定为保护区。

words.definition: vt. 提供；规定；准备；装备
words.example: Tea and biscuits will be provided.
words.exampleTranslation: 有茶水和饼干供应。

words.definition: n. 讨论会，座谈会；专题论文集；酒宴，宴会
words.example: He had been taking part in an international symposium on population.
words.exampleTranslation: 他那时在参加一个有关人口的国际研讨会。

words.definition: adj. 工艺的，科技的；技术上的；专门的
words.example: Our staff will be available to give you technical support .
words.exampleTranslation: 有我们的员工向你提供技术支持。

words.definition: adj. [经]个人的；个别的；独特的
words.example: Each individual leaf on the tree is different.
words.exampleTranslation: 树上每片叶子都不相同。

words.definition: vt. 提出；介绍；呈现；赠送
words.example: Foreign observers were present at the elections.
words.exampleTranslation: 外国观察员出席了选举。

words.definition: n. [化学]水银；水银柱；精神
words.example: Some thieves have eaten off their irons with mercury water.
words.exampleTranslation: 有些窃贼用汞水腐蚀他们的镣铐。

words.definition: n. 水平；标准；水平面
words.example: Inflation fell to its lowest level in 30 years.
words.exampleTranslation: 通货膨胀降至30年来最低点。

words.definition: adv. 简单地；仅仅；简直；朴素地；坦白地
words.example: That would be simply wonderful!
words.exampleTranslation: 那简直太棒了！

words.definition: n. 偏移；远足；短程旅行；离题；游览圆
words.example: Included in the tour is an excursion to the Grand Canyon.
words.exampleTranslation: 这次旅游包括大峡谷观光。

words.definition: n. [医]绷带
words.example: We put some ointment and a bandage on his knee.
words.exampleTranslation: 我们在他的膝盖上涂了些药膏，还缠了一条绷带。

words.definition: n. [遗]基因，遗传因子
words.example: human genes
words.exampleTranslation: 人类基因

words.definition: n. 再生；再循环；重复利用
words.example: The objective would be to recycle 98 percent of domestic waste.
words.exampleTranslation: 该目标是循环使用98%的生活垃圾。

words.definition: n. 总统；董事长；校长
words.example: President Bush
words.exampleTranslation: 布什总统

words.definition: adj. 明智的；明显的；意识到的；通晓事理的
words.example: She seems very sensible.
words.exampleTranslation: 她好像很明智。

words.definition: adj. 空的；赤裸的，无遮蔽的
words.example: a ragged child with bare feet
words.exampleTranslation: 一个衣衫褴褛、光着脚的小孩

words.definition: n. [数]定义；[物]清晰度；解说
words.example: a dictionary definition
words.exampleTranslation: 词典里的释义

words.definition: n. 接待；接收；招待会；感受；反应
words.example: She was unsure of her reception after everything that had happened.
words.exampleTranslation: 发生了这些事后，她对自己是否还受欢迎没把握。

words.definition: n. 王子，国君；亲王；贵族
words.example: Prince William
words.exampleTranslation: 威廉王子

words.definition: vt. 转移；分心
words.example: Try not to distract the other students.
words.exampleTranslation: 尽量不要让其他学生分心。

words.definition: vt. 容纳；使适应；供应；调解
words.example: The island was used to accommodate child refugees.
words.exampleTranslation: 该岛用于收容儿童难民。

words.definition: n. 秘书；书记；部长；大臣
words.example: My secretary will fax you all the details.
words.exampleTranslation: 我的秘书会把所有的细节发传真给你。

words.definition: n. 郡，县
words.example: Fairfax County, Virginia
words.exampleTranslation: 弗吉尼亚州费尔法克斯县

words.definition: n. [植]存在；出席；参加；风度；仪态
words.example: Your presence is requested at the club meeting on Friday.
words.exampleTranslation: 敬请出席于周五举行的俱乐部会议。

words.definition: n. 原谅；[法]赦免；宽恕
words.example: Walter begged her pardon for all the pain he had caused her.
words.exampleTranslation: 沃尔特请求她原谅自己给她造成那么多痛苦。

words.definition: adj. 愉快的；微醉的；嬉戏作乐的
words.example: He marched off, whistling a merry tune.
words.exampleTranslation: 他吹着一首欢快的曲子大步走了。

words.definition: vi. 转变，变换；皈依；改变信仰
words.example: The signal will be converted into digital code.
words.exampleTranslation: 信号将被转变成数字编码。

words.definition: n. 限制；限度；界线
words.example: a 55 mph speed limit
words.exampleTranslation: 55英里的时速限制

words.definition: vt. 包括；采访，报导；涉及
words.example: Grey mould covered the walls.
words.exampleTranslation: 灰色的霉菌布满了墙面。

words.definition: adj. 明显的；明白的
words.example: Bob ate his lunch with evident enjoyment.
words.exampleTranslation: 显然鲍勃吃午饭吃得津津有味。

words.definition: n. 罪犯
words.example: Police have described the man as a violent and dangerous criminal.
words.exampleTranslation: 警方形容那名男子是个凶暴而危险的罪犯。

words.definition: vt. 表示；意味；预示
words.example: Some tribes use special facial markings to signify status.
words.exampleTranslation: 有些部落使用特殊的面部标记来表示地位。

words.definition: prep. 在旁边；与…相比；和…无关
words.example: Wendy came up and sat beside me.
words.exampleTranslation: 温迪走过来，坐在我身边。

words.definition: adj. 手工的；体力的
words.example: People in manual occupations have a lower life expectancy.
words.exampleTranslation: 干体力活的人预期寿命较短。

words.definition: n. 宿舍（等于dormitory）
words.example: But I had no food in my dorm, so I had to go to canteen.
words.exampleTranslation: 但是我在宿舍没有东西可吃，所以我只能去餐厅了。

words.definition: n. 马戏；马戏团
words.example: My real ambition was to work in a circus.
words.exampleTranslation: 我真正的理想是去马戏团工作。

words.definition: n. 浴室；厕所；盥洗室
words.example: Where’s the bathroom?
words.exampleTranslation: 洗手间在哪里？

words.definition: adj. 浪漫的；多情的；空想的
words.example: ‘Tom always sends me red roses on my birthday.’ ‘How romantic!’
words.exampleTranslation: “我过生日时汤姆总是给我送红玫瑰。”“多浪漫啊！”

words.definition: n. 推销员；[贸易]售货员
words.example: ...an insurance salesman.
words.exampleTranslation: …一位男保险推销员。

words.definition: n. 好奇，好奇心；珍品，古董，古玩
words.example: I opened the packet just to satisfy my curiosity .
words.exampleTranslation: 我打开包裹只是为了满足我的好奇心。

words.definition: n. 学科；[管理]纪律；训练；惩罚
words.example: serious discipline problems in the police force
words.exampleTranslation: 警察队伍内严重的纪律问题

words.definition: adj. [数]平等的；相等的；胜任的
words.example: Both candidates received an equal number of votes.
words.exampleTranslation: 两位候选人的得票数相等。

words.definition: n. 军人；[昆]兵蚁；懒汉；一片烤面包
words.example: A British soldier was wounded in the fighting.
words.exampleTranslation: 战斗中，有一名英国士兵受了伤。

words.definition: adv. 仅仅，勉强；几乎不；公开地；贫乏地
words.example: She was very old and barely able to walk.
words.exampleTranslation: 她年纪非常大，只能勉强走几步路。

words.definition: adj. 最终的；决定性的；不可更改的
words.example: The final episode will be shown tonight.
words.exampleTranslation: 最后一集将于今晚播出。

words.definition: n. 界限，边界
words.example: We confined our study to ten cases.
words.exampleTranslation: 我们把研究限定在十个案例以内。

words.definition: n. 动物，生物；人；创造物
words.example: all the living creatures in the sea
words.exampleTranslation: 海洋中所有的生物

words.definition: n. 共产主义
words.example: ...the ultimate triumph of communism in the world.
words.exampleTranslation: …共产主义在全世界的最终胜利。

words.definition: v. 欺骗；行骗
words.example: He had been deceived by a young man claiming to be the son of a millionaire.
words.exampleTranslation: 他被一个自称是百万富翁之子的年轻人骗了。

words.definition: v. 描述…特性
words.example: The group was characterized as being well-educated and liberal.
words.exampleTranslation: 该群体被描绘成受过良好教育，思想开明。

words.definition: n. 基础；底部；主要成分；基本原则或原理
words.example: Their claim had no basis in fact (=  it was not true  ) .
words.exampleTranslation: 他们的说法没有事实根据。

words.definition: n. [生物]物种；种类
words.example: Seven species of birds of prey have been observed.
words.exampleTranslation: 已有七种猛禽被观察到。

words.definition: n. 部分；角色；零件
words.example: For part of the day, you will be outside doing practical work.
words.exampleTranslation: 你们每天将有一部分时间在户外实际操作。

words.definition: vt. 总结；概述
words.example: The authors summarize their views in the introduction.
words.exampleTranslation: 作者在序言里概述了他们的观点。

words.definition: n. 信号；暗号；导火线
words.example: At a prearranged signal the lights went out.
words.exampleTranslation: 预定的信号一发出，灯就全灭了。

words.definition: vi. 传播，流传；循环；流通
words.example: Swimming helps to get the blood circulating through the muscles.
words.exampleTranslation: 游泳有助于肌肉的血液循环。

words.definition: adj. 宗教的；虔诚的；严谨的；修道的
words.example: I don’t share her religious beliefs .
words.exampleTranslation: 她的宗教信仰和我的不同。

words.definition: vt. 残杀；彻底击败
words.example: The army massacred more than 150 unarmed civilians.
words.exampleTranslation: 军队屠杀了150多名手无寸铁的平民。

words.definition: n. 减少，减小；减少量
words.example: In Spain and Portugal there has been a decrease in the number of young people out of work.
words.exampleTranslation: 在西班牙和葡萄牙，失业青年人数已经有所下降。

words.definition: n. 农村，乡下；乡下的全体居民
words.example: The house had lovely views over open countryside .
words.exampleTranslation: 这房子望出去是开阔的乡村美景。

words.definition: n. 改进，改善
words.example: Our results have shown some improvement this month.
words.exampleTranslation: 我们的成绩这个月有所提高。

words.definition: n. [数]精度，精密度；精确
words.example: The work was carried out with military precision (= the work was done in a carefully planned and exact way ) .
words.exampleTranslation: 这项工作做得严谨细致，有如军事行动。

words.definition: vt. 假设；认为；让（虚拟语气）；推想
words.example: There were many more deaths than was first supposed.
words.exampleTranslation: 死亡人数远远超过最初的预料。

words.definition: n. [安全]事故；意外；[法]意外事件；机遇
words.example: Ken had an accident at work and had to go to hospital.
words.exampleTranslation: 肯在工作中出了事故，不得不去医院。

words.definition: vt. 包含；由…组成
words.example: The house comprises two bedrooms, a kitchen, and a living room.
words.exampleTranslation: 这座房子有两间卧室、一间厨房和一间起居室。

words.definition: n. （美）分；便士
words.example: Unleaded petrol rose more than a penny a gallon.
words.exampleTranslation: 无铅汽油每加仑涨了一个多便士。

words.definition: vt. 比较；对照；比喻为
words.example: The report compares the different types of home computer available.
words.exampleTranslation: 这份报告比较了市场上不同类型的家用计算机。

words.definition: n. 性格，品质；特性；角色；[计]字符
words.example: He has a cheerful but quiet character.
words.exampleTranslation: 他的性格乐观文静。

words.definition: n. 天才，天赋；精神
words.example: The film reveals Fellini’s genius.
words.exampleTranslation: 这部影片展现了费里尼的天赋。

words.definition: vt. 致力；献身；题献
words.example: For the next few years, she dedicated herself to her work.
words.exampleTranslation: 随后的几年里，她全身心地投入工作。

words.definition: vt. 揭露，揭发；使曝光；显示
words.example: The report revealed that workers had been exposed to high levels of radiation.
words.exampleTranslation: 报告披露工人们受到了高强度的辐射。

words.definition: adj. 正式的；拘谨的；有条理的
words.example: formal recognition of the reformed church
words.exampleTranslation: 改革后的教会所获得的官方承认

words.definition: adj. 相同的；同一的；上述的（通常与the连用）；无变化的
words.example: He sits in the same chair every night.
words.exampleTranslation: 他每天晚上都坐在同一把椅子上。

words.definition: adj. 必然的，不可避免的
words.example: A further escalation of the crisis now seems inevitable.
words.exampleTranslation: 危机的进一步升级现在看来已不可避免。

words.definition: n. [法]嫌疑犯
words.example: She strongly suspected he was lying to her.
words.exampleTranslation: 她非常怀疑他在对她撒谎。

words.definition: n. 资本主义
words.example: ...the two fundamentally opposed social systems, capitalism and socialism.
words.exampleTranslation: …两种根本对立的社会制度，资本主义与社会主义。

words.definition: vt. 执行；完成；演奏
words.example: Chenier and the band are performing at the Silver Palace tomorrow.
words.exampleTranslation: 车尼尔和乐队明天将在银宫演出。

words.definition: adj. 中世纪的；原始的；仿中世纪的；老式的
words.example: These spices were first brought to Italy from the East in medieval times.
words.exampleTranslation: 这些香料最早是在中世纪时从东方被带到了意大利。

words.definition: n. 卡通片，[电影]动画片；连环漫画
words.example: cartoon characters such as Donald Duck
words.exampleTranslation: 唐老鸭一类的卡通人物

words.definition: adj. [数]有限的
words.example: My knowledge of the business is limited.
words.exampleTranslation: 我对这一行了解有限。

words.definition: adj. 可能的；合理的；合适的
words.example: Is it possible toget tickets for the game?
words.exampleTranslation: 有没有可能弄到比赛的门票？

words.definition: vt. 提取；取出；[图情]摘录；榨取
words.example: You’ll have to have that tooth extracted.
words.exampleTranslation: 你得把那颗牙拔掉。

words.definition: n. [交]集装箱；[包装]容器
words.example: ice cream in plastic containers
words.exampleTranslation: 塑料容器里的冰激凌

words.definition: n. 威胁；恐吓
words.example: The elephants are still menaced by poachers.
words.exampleTranslation: 大象仍然面临非法捕猎者的威胁。

words.definition: vi. 坚持；依附；粘着；追随
words.example: The eggs of these fish adhere to plant leaves.
words.exampleTranslation: 这些鱼产下的卵附着在植物叶片上。

words.definition: adv. 此外；而且
words.example: I need the money. And besides, when I agree to do something, I do it.
words.exampleTranslation: 我需要这笔钱，而且，我一旦答应做什么事情就会做到。

words.definition: n. 类似物；类似情况；对等的人
words.example: analogue method
words.exampleTranslation: 相似法；模拟法；类比法

words.definition: n. 交谈；会话；社交
words.example: a telephone conversation
words.exampleTranslation: 电话交谈

words.definition: n. 自豪；骄傲；自尊心
words.example: He wore his medals with pride.
words.exampleTranslation: 他自豪地戴着奖章。

words.definition: adj. 重大的；有效的；有意义的；值得注意的；意味深长的
words.example: His most significant political achievement was the abolition of the death penalty.
words.exampleTranslation: 他政治上最重大的成就是废除了死刑。

words.definition: adj. [贸易]互惠的；相互的；[数]倒数的，彼此相反的
words.example: He spoke of the necessity for a reciprocal relationship that would be useful for all sides.
words.exampleTranslation: 他谈及需要建立对各方都有益的互惠关系。

words.definition: adv. 向前；（门等）关上
words.example: She stood up and walked to the window.
words.exampleTranslation: 她站起来走到窗前。

words.definition: n. 完善；完美
words.example: My father expected perfection from all of us.
words.exampleTranslation: 父亲期望我们都尽善尽美。

words.definition: n. 拥有；财产；领地；自制；着迷
words.example: That information is not in our possession.
words.exampleTranslation: 那则信息不归我们所有。
